summary: drakefjustin 发布 EF 协议的 strawmap 路线草图，VitalikButerin 随后逐项解读，先谈快速 slot 与快速最终性，倾向按根号 2 逐步缩短 slot。ACDE #231 把执行层头号候选收窄为 EIP-8141 或不设头号，下次 ACDE 决定；EIP-8105 撤回后，LUCID 是唯一的加密交易池提案。rakita 提交可组合交易 EIP，作为 EIP-8141 的更简单替代。

items.title: ACDE #231
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #13：执行层头号下次 ACDE 决定，领先选项是 EIP-8141 frame 交易或不设头号，Geth、Erigon、Besu 与 Nimbus 已提交偏好；加密交易池方面，EIP-8105 撤回后 LUCID 是唯一提案；EraE 执行层历史归档格式取代 Era1。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #13: the execution layer headliner will be decided next ACDE, with EIP-8141 frame transactions or no headliner leading and Geth, Erigon, Besu and Nimbus having posted preferences; for encrypted pools, LUCID is the sole proposal after EIP-8105 was withdrawn; the EraE execution history archive format supersedes Era1.

items.title: 新增 EIP：Composable Transaction
items.note: （rakita）提交：新的 EIP-2718 交易类型，带可扩展的能力式签名与原生交易赞助，作为 EIP-8141 的更简单替代，不引入新操作码、执行 frame 或按 frame 的 gas 记账，由付款方共同签名并承担 gas。
items.note_en: (rakita), submitted: a new EIP-2718 transaction type with extensible capability based signatures and native sponsorship, a simpler alternative to EIP-8141 with no new opcodes, execution frames or per frame gas accounting, where the payer co signs and is charged for gas.

keywords_en: ACDE #231 narrows the execution layer headliner to EIP-8141 or none
LUCID is the sole encrypted pool proposal after EIP-8105 is withdrawn
summary_en: drakefjustin published EF Protocol's strawmap, and VitalikButerin walked through it goal by goal, starting with fast slots and fast finality and favoring cutting slot time by sqrt 2 steps. ACDE #231 narrowed the execution layer headliner to EIP-8141 or no headliner, to be decided next ACDE; with EIP-8105 withdrawn, LUCID is the only encrypted pool proposal. rakita submitted the Composable Transaction EIP as a simpler alternative to EIP-8141.
